subject: Mid-cycle top-up and co-term billing alignment
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@solstice.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity top-up and aligning billing for co-term

Hi Stephanie —

Quick note from our side: we’re seeing an unexpected usage spike in Q3 and will need an additional 25% capacity for the next 3 months. We’d like to avoid an immediate price step-up and instead explore:

- A phased top-up (spread billing across remaining months)
- Bringing the added capacity onto the same contract end date (co-term) with our March 2026 renewal
- Any available volume discount or short-term credit given this was unplanned usage

Attached is our recent usage export (Solstice_Q3_usage.pdf) so you can see the pattern. Can you confirm feasible options and an estimated incremental cost? We’re prepared to commit if the billing can be smoothed.

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Head of Platform
Solstice AI

Attachment: Solstice_Q3_usage.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@solstice.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up and aligning billing for co-term

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the usage export — helpful. Short answer: we can accommodate a phased top-up and co-term the additional capacity into your March 2026 renewal. High-level options I’m proposing (attached spreadsheet):

1) Staged top-up (recommended)
   - 25% capacity add implemented immediately
   - Billing staggered across remaining 6 billing cycles (smoothed)
   - One-time implementation fee waived

2) Immediate add with prorated invoice
   - Full charge in next invoice, then credits applied across next 3 months

3) Short-term credit + staged billing (middle ground)
   - 10% usage credit for the first 30 days to cover the unexpected spike
   - Staged billing as option 1 thereafter

Discounts: for a 6-month committed uplift we can offer tiered effective discounts depending on annualized uplift: 5–12% off token rates (see spreadsheet). If you confirm the path, I’ll draft an amendment and route to finance for approval.

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether the team can sign an amendment this week?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood_pricing_options.xlsx (XLSX, pricing breakdown)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-24T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up and aligning billing for co-term

Thanks for the context — looped in. Internally: we have headroom to approve a staged top-up with up to a 12% effective discount on token rates for a 6-month locked uplift, provided the amendment includes:

- A committed uplift quantity and a rollback clause at month 7 if usage normalizes
- Clear billing stagger schedule (month-by-month breakdown)
- Legal confirmation on data handling for the extra capacity (no changes expected)

If Stephanie sends an amendment draft and the HubSpot deal is updated (SOL-3892), I’ll fast-track finance approval.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Note: internal approval threshold set at 12% — anything beyond requires VP sign-off.

From: Elena Morales <elena@solstice.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-24T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up and aligning billing for co-term

On Wed, Sep 24, 2025 at 8:45 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the context — looped in. Internally: we have headroom to approve a staged top-up with up to a 12% effective discount...

Thanks, Ben — that sounds workable. Preference: option 3 (10% short-term credit + staged billing) with a 6-month uplift term and explicit month-by-month billing schedule so our finance team can reconcile.

Two quick asks before we sign:
- Can you shorten the billing stagger so it’s spread over 4 months instead of 6? That helps our cash-flow planning.
- Please include a single-sentence rollback clause (if usage drops below baseline for 2 consecutive months, billing returns to baseline next cycle).

If you can send a one-page amendment and DocuSign link with those two points reflected, we’ll push to sign this week.

Thanks —
Elena

Attachment: (none)

Elena Morales
Head of Platform, Solstice AI
elena@solstice.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-25T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity top-up and aligning billing for co-term

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I’ve attached a 1-page amendment draft that reflects:

- Option 3 pathway: 10% usage credit for first 30 days
- Staged uplift of 25% with billing staggered across 4 months (per your request)
- 6-month uplift term that co-terminates with existing contract (March 31, 2026)
- Rollback clause: if usage is below baseline for 2 consecutive months, uplift billing ends the following cycle

Ben — per your note, credit capped at 12% effective discount; amendment shows 10% credit plus staged billing to keep within threshold. I’ve also updated the HubSpot deal (SOL-3892) and included the DocuSign link.
